findings.title: Vehicle handoff per-flight check reads "3V3 at TP81"; TP81 is RAW_PROTECTED

evidence.measured: native board: TP81 pad 1 net RAW_PROTECTED at B(31.0,84.8); the 3V3 probe is C15.1 B(29.05,47.82) (net 3V3); no 3V3 test pad exists (TPs: TP74/TP88 GND, TP80 BAT_IN, TP81 RAW_PROTECTED, TP82 USB_LIMITED, TP83 VLOGIC, TP120 RAW_ACT, TP122 PYRO1_GATE)

findings.impact: The per-flight "board off with J400 open" check is a safety-procedure step (H-6, R19-SAF-02, R20-SAF-01). findings.title: C87 sentence "worst case 10.6 ms at 6.0 V ..., below the 10 ms criterion" reads as if 10.6 ms were below 10 ms

evidence.measured: D-R20-11 figures: 10.6 ms at 6.0 V (meets 10 ms), 8.5 ms at 5.73 V and 6.6 ms at 5.5 V (below it); 10 ms needs >= 5.92 V. AGENTS, REQUIREMENTS F6 / line 102, ORDERING 8.3 and the binding note state this correctly.

findings.impact: Readability only; the numbers are right, but the clause attaches "below the criterion" to the 6.0 V figure that passes it.
findings.concrete_fix: Rewrite as: "worst case 10.6 ms at 6.0 V (meets the 10 ms criterion); about 8.5 ms at the four-stall 5.73 V and 6.6 ms at 5.5 V fall below it, so 10 ms needs a loaded pack of at least 5.92 V (D-R20-11)".
